nested_excluded.why: Secret values are runtime-only: the server resolves them, and a template names secrets instead.

policy.name: allowed_domains
policy.meaning: The organisation's default allowlist applies. An empty list is a choice: nothing is reachable unless a component adds it.

policy.name: denied_domains
policy.meaning: Managed denials still apply. A template that drops its own denial can widen access.

policy.name: allow_all_egress
policy.meaning: Egress follows the baseline. False is a choice of default-deny.

policy.name: first_use_approval
policy.meaning: Unknown destinations are handled as the baseline says.

policy.name: first_use_hold_seconds
policy.meaning: A held connection waits the built-in time. Zero is the same.

policy.name: max_holds
policy.meaning: The built-in cap on concurrent holds applies. Zero is the same.

policy.name: allowed_methods
policy.meaning: Methods follow the baseline. An empty list allows every method.

policy.name: min_confinement_class
policy.meaning: The floor follows the organisation's. A template cannot lower a managed floor.

policy.name: eligible_grants
policy.meaning: No credential eligibility comes from the template: the person's own ceiling decides.

policy.name: auto_stop_after_sec
policy.meaning: Idle stop follows the baseline. Zero or a negative number is a choice to never stop for idleness.

policy.name: workspace_mounts
policy.meaning: No host path is mounted.

policy.name: workspace_repos
policy.meaning: No extra repository is cloned.

policy.name: llm_inspection
policy.meaning: Content inspection follows the organisation's policy, off unless it is turned on.

policy.name: ui_apps
policy.meaning: No application is declared for the browser.

policy.name: resources
policy.meaning: Limits follow the platform defaults. A zero field means the default.

policy.name: tool_rules
policy.meaning: No tool rules are added.

policy.name: git_push_any_branch
policy.meaning: Pushes stay inside the run's own branch namespace. False is a choice to keep that.

policy.name: push_rules
policy.meaning: Push rules exist only inside an SCM entry, one set per provider and organisation. This run-wide block is not accepted until the keyed carrier lands.

policy.name: azure_devops_capabilities
policy.meaning: The provider's default profile applies.

policy.name: github_capabilities
policy.meaning: The provider's default profile applies.

request.name: agent
request.meaning: No agent is chosen. A background agent task needs one; a command or an interactive environment does not. A task is never turned into a shell command.

request.name: repo
request.meaning: No repository is attached through this older single-repository field.

request.name: task
request.meaning: No task text is carried: the person who uses the template writes it.

request.name: title
request.why: A run is named when it is launched: the Name this run dialog opens empty in this release, so a template carries no title.

request.name: description
request.why: A run is described when it is launched: the Name this run dialog opens empty in this release, so a template carries no description.

request.name: policy_id
request.meaning: The organisation's default policy applies when the template is used, and that default can change. It is a whole reference and never appears beside inline_policy.

request.name: confinement_class
request.meaning: The barrier follows the organisation's default and floor when the template is used.

request.name: interactive
request.meaning: No run mode is assumed: the person chooses Background task or Interactive environment. false is the choice of a background task.

request.name: workspace_id
request.meaning: No workspace is attached through this older single-workspace field.

request.name: inline_policy
request.meaning: No policy field is set by the template. Only the policy keys it names are laid onto the source policy; a key it leaves out keeps the source's value.

request.name: devcontainer_repo
request.meaning: No image is built from a repository.

request.name: devcontainer_ref
request.meaning: The build uses the repository's default branch.

request.name: image
request.meaning: No image of the person's own is named: the run uses the agent's or the organisation's image.

request.name: task_mode
request.meaning: Under a background task the person chooses an agent task or a command. A harness is inferred only when an agent is present, and a task is never turned into a command.

request.name: interactive_start
request.meaning: Nothing starts automatically unless chosen. A removed startup tool is never replaced by another.

request.name: seed_auto_tools
request.meaning: The starting prompt asks before using tools. False is a choice to keep asking.

request.name: tool_approvals
request.meaning: Tool use follows the default approval behaviour.

request.name: workspaces
request.meaning: No workspace is attached. An empty list says no workspace; it is not the tab's explicit choice of no repositories or drives.

request.name: integration_id
request.why: The server refuses integration_id at launch. Choose a model provider instead.

request.name: model_provider
request.meaning: The run uses the model provider the person's defaults give.

request.name: drive
request.meaning: No drive is attached or declined. enabled false is a choice to leave the drive out.

request.name: components
request.meaning: No component is attached.

request.name: allowed_image
request.meaning: No image is chosen from the organisation's allowed list.

request.name: placement
request.meaning: The run is placed by the pool defaults when the template is used.

request.name: runner_id
request.meaning: No runner is pinned: any of the person's eligible runners may take the run.

request.name: resources
request.meaning: CPU and memory follow the placement's defaults. A zero field asks for the default.

request.name: overrides
request.meaning: No per-run edits are applied to components.

request.name: preset
request.why: A preset is a launch shortcut. A template records its own origin, and the setup it holds is carried field by field.

request.name: preset_version
request.why: A preset's version only means something beside its preset.

request.name: runner_pool_id
request.meaning: The pool follows the organisation's default and the person's own default when the template is used.

request.name: experience
request.meaning: No mode is assumed: Background task or Interactive environment is chosen.

request.name: included_tools
request.meaning: No harness is included. An interactive environment may include several, and including none is valid.

request.name: startup
request.meaning: Nothing starts automatically unless chosen: one included harness, one command, or none.

request.name: starting_folder
request.meaning: The first attached repository, or the sandbox's default working directory when none is attached.

request.name: no_repositories_or_drives
request.meaning: The tab stays incomplete until something is attached or the person explicitly chooses no repositories or drives. Choosing none warns that nothing in the sandbox is kept unless it is pushed or copied out.
